papers_read.title_as_printed: Alzheimer's Disease Prediction Algorithm Based on Group Convolution and a Joint Loss Function (Cheng et al., Comput Math Methods Med 2022, Article ID 1854718)
Predicting cognitive decline: Deep-learning reveals subtle brain changes in pre-MCI stage (Yue et al., J Prev Alz Dis 2025)

what_each_reports.P-218: Group-convolution ResNet18 with hybrid attention on 2D slices of ADNI FDG-PET, classifying AD vs MCI vs NC (three classes); trained on ADNI-1 (190 AD/350 MCI/200 NC), tested on 400 ADNI-2 images (124 AD/192 MCI/84 NC); ACC 89.4%, AUC 92.3%, SEN 87.43, SPE 88.26.
what_each_reports.P-146: ROI-based deep-learning Progressive Index from baseline T1 MRI, trained on ADNI-1 (AD+pMCI vs NC+sMCI) and applied to cognitively normal/SCD older adults to predict progression to MCI: ADNI-2 (3-year) AUC 0.7048; CLAS (7-year) PI alone AUC 0.711; PI combined with age, gender, education and associative-learning score AUC 0.812 (95% CI 0.725-0.900).

quantity_a: ROI-AUC for concurrent three-class diagnosis AD/MCI/NC from FDG-PET slices in ADNI (diagnostic classification, no future horizon).
quantity_b: ROC-AUC for predicting 7-year conversion from normal cognition (NC or SCD) to amnestic MCI in a Shanghai community cohort (CLAS), using a T1-MRI index plus demographic and one neuropsychological score.
incompatible_if_same: No. Even if taken as the same metric type, 0.923 vs 0.812 (CI 0.725-0.900) are single-study estimates from different tasks; neither study claims an ordering the other refutes. A lower AUC for 7-year prediction from normal cognition than for concurrent diagnosis of established AD/MCI is expected, not contradictory.

gates.task: mismatch: P-218 is concurrent diagnosis of AD/MCI/NC (registry itself codes P-218 as T3, the record says T2); P-146 is prognosis of NC/SCD to MCI conversion
gates.dataset_family: mismatch for the contested figure: P-218 uses ADNI-1/ADNI-2; P-146's 0.812 is from the CLAS cohort (Shanghai), although its model was trained on ADNI-1
gates.validation_tier: not equal: P-218 is a held-out ADNI-2 test set (same consortium); P-146's 0.812 is on an independent external cohort (CLAS)
gates.modality_family: mismatch: FDG-PET (P-218) vs structural T1 MRI plus clinical variables (P-146); the record's 'structural_mri' does not fit P-218

endpoint_and_metric: incompatible: both are ROC-AUCs, but one is a three-class diagnostic AUC and the other a binary 7-year conversion AUC in a different population
performance_validity: flag does not apply (AUC 0.923 and 0.812, neither at or above 0.97); the comparison is a performance comparison but on different estimands
independence: Distinct studies, no shared authors; P-146 trained on ADNI-1 and P-218 trained on ADNI-1 PET, so ADNI-1 participants may overlap in training data, but the contested figure of P-146 comes from CLAS.
grounds: P-218 reports a three-class AD/MCI/NC diagnostic AUC on FDG-PET, not a conversion prediction.
P-146's 0.812 is a 7-year NC/SCD-to-MCI conversion AUC in the CLAS cohort from an MRI index combined with clinical measures.
Task, population, dataset, horizon and modality all differ, so the 0.923 vs 0.812 gap is not a disagreement on one quantity.

evidence_quotes.quote: We use 190 AD cases, 350 MCI cases, and 200 NC cases among PET images as the training data from ADNI-1. Four hundred PET images are selected as the test data from ADNI-2.
This demonstrates the effectiveness of the group convolutional network for the three classification tasks.
Better performance for prediction progression to MCI in CLAS was obtained when the PI score was combined with clinical measures (AUC = 0.812; 95 %CI: 0.725-0.900).
can effectively predict the conversion of MCI in the CLAS cohort after 7 years, with an AUC of 0.812

record_defects: claim_a writes 'AUC 92.3' on a 0-100 scale while claim_b writes 'AUC 0.812'; gap_magnitude 0.111 silently rescales.
Task gate recorded as equal (T2), but P-218 is a concurrent three-class diagnostic study (the registry codes it T3) and P-146 is NC/SCD-to-MCI prognosis.
modality_family recorded as structural_mri, but P-218 uses FDG-PET only.
dataset_equal 'Yes' overlooks that P-146's 0.812 is from the CLAS cohort, not ADNI.
claim_b still labels the paper P-310 (the dedup predecessor of P-146).
what_would_change_the_verdict: Nothing in these two papers: a genuine test would need two studies reporting the same endpoint (e.g. three-class FDG-PET diagnosis on ADNI, or NC-to-MCI conversion at a matched horizon) with non-overlapping uncertainty.
